links.comparator_used: Same system without self-consistency (single response per note)
links.outcome: Macro-averaged F1 for irAE extraction in retrospective notes
links.quote: Retrospectively (263 notes), the system achieved macro-averaged F1 of 0.92 for detection and 0.66 for multi-class severity grading; self-consistency improved F1 by 0.14.

links.comparator_used: Manual annotation by clinical trial staff without agentic assistance (randomized crossover)
links.outcome: Annotation time, complete-match accuracy and inter-annotator agreement
links.effect: Annotation time reduced by 40% (P < 0.001); complete-match accuracy OR 1.45 (95% CI 1.01–2.09; P = 0.045); Krippendorff's α rose from 0.22–0.51 to 0.82–0.85
links.quote: In a randomized crossover study of clinical trial staff (17 participants, 316 observations), agentic assistance reduced annotation time by 40% (P < 0.001), increased complete-match accuracy (OR 1.45; 95% CI 1.01–2.09; P = 0.045), and improved inter-annotator agreement (Krippendorff’s α from 0.22–0.51 to 0.82–0.85).

design_hint: silent-mode deployment and human verification of AI outputs
